scope: Only Grammar two finite error-surface closures and bounded-capture count interpretation. No new field, role, report key, capability or implementation.
duplicate_order: After all step2 structural/domain/size checks, inspect duplicate pins within binding.external_tcb_pins, then binding.prior_metadata_pins, each left-to-right by list ordinal. Same id+bytes+sha256 yields POLICY_DUPLICATE_ID; same id with differing bytes or SHA yields POLICY_PIN_CONFLICT.
Then inspect repeated IDs within binding.current_output_ids and binding.basis_ids in that order: POLICY_DUPLICATE_ID.

Then inspect cross-role binding ID overlap in role-group order external_tcb_pins,prior_metadata_pins,current_decision_id,current_output_ids,basis_ids. Any repeated ID from an earlier distinct group is POLICY_PIN_CONFLICT, even identical pin bytes/hash.

Then inspect duplicate IDs within envelope.current_output_ids,external_anchor_ids,basis_ids in that order: POLICY_DUPLICATE_ID. Then cross-role overlap in order external_anchor_ids,current_decision_id,current_output_ids,basis_ids is POLICY_PIN_CONFLICT.

Then inspect nodes in declaration order: identical same-ID node values yield POLICY_DUPLICATE_ID; differing same-ID node values yield POLICY_PIN_CONFLICT. Compare only already-detached exact builtin values; do not call custom equality.
Then inspect each node pin_dependencies list in node order and edge order: a repeated target ID is POLICY_DUPLICATE_ID. No deduplication changes the graph or bypasses a cap.
text_order: Exact str type first. ID length>128 or reason length>256 yields POLICY_LIMIT before pattern/Unicode/state-relation checks. With a valid length, invalid ID ASCII/fullmatch or a reason lone surrogate yields POLICY_DOMAIN. A257-codepoint reason that also includes a surrogate is POLICY_LIMIT. Digest lexical/fixed64-length violations are POLICY_DOMAIN, not the ID text limit.
edge_limit: During bounded step2 capture, total_pin_edges counts every declared pin_dependencies item, including repeats, before any duplicate semantics. More than4096 yields POLICY_LIMIT. On a valid graph the report edge_count is the same declared count, which is necessarily unique.
unchanged: All graph roles/ancestry/modes/binding/clock/report/EntryPlan joins and12 report fields remain as the effective draft. No subject imports, code or execution.
